normal_boot_findings.result: Rule remains in stock, but /sbin/asus_mmc does not exist; stock rc also lacks its dispatch string. No MMC-to-USB major-8 emulation is available.
Actual eMMC major 179 does not pass the major-8 USB disk condition. Same-pin source supports the model flag evidence.
Exact ARM addresses 0xdf6c/0xdf70/0xdf74 reject any /proc/partitions major other than 8 before creating disk data. Disk UI, NAS disk enumeration and start_diskformat source consume this list.

Bulk mount/unmount enumeration requires a /hostN/targetN:N:N/N:N:N:N SCSI link. The exact read-only live MMC links are sdhci/mmc_host/mmc0 and ../../../mmc0:0001, so they cannot pass this shape check.
Creates /dev/PARTNAME and /dev/disk/by-label/PARTNAME aliases from GPT PARTNAME; no mount/format. These are partition-name aliases, not ext4 filesystem-label ignore rules.
Normal named storage mounts only data, defaults, misc, jffs and aiboard. Existing mounted mandatory partitions return before create_mng_partition. A uniquely named p11 is not configured for mounting.

destructive_recovery.trigger: A mandatory defaults/jffs/aiboard partition is absent, create_mng_partition runs, and requested capacity exceeds trailing free space (or is zero), while capacity after data is sufficient.
destructive_recovery.effect: Stock sgdisk deletes every partition with number greater than the data partition, including p8/p9/p10 and an added p11, then reconstructs mandatory partitions and requests reboot.
destructive_recovery.separate_existing_filesystem_failure: Stock mount_data/partitioncfg may format the named existing defaults/data/misc/jffs/aiboard partition after its mount fails; it does not select arbitrary p11 by ext4 label.
destructive_recovery.unalloc_name: create_mng_partition also deletes a partition whose GPT dump matches unalloc before capacity calculation; do not use that GPT name.

required_activation_checks: Bind the intended old-slot firmware to these exact ELF/script hashes; a firmware update requires re-audit.
Before any future partition change, preserve all existing partition start/end/GPT names/UUIDs and verify primary+backup GPT consistency.
Use a unique p11 GPT PARTNAME without reserved stock-name substrings or unalloc; filesystem label alone is not a quarantine mechanism.
Verify mandatory partitions remain healthy, present and correctly named; a damaged/missing mandatory layout is outside safe stock recovery for appended p11.
Read-only verify actual MMC sysfs device links are not SCSI /host/target paths.
limits: No physical p11 exists in this test, no GPT/filesystem/partition writes were performed.
No ASUS executable, shell script, constructor, mount, format or service was run.
Normal boot USB exclusion is static evidence, not a blanket promise that unmodified recovery firmware can never delete appended user partitions.
No documented or implemented stock per-label ignore policy protects p11 against partitioncfg reconstruction.
